## Types

### AcquireMetadata

A enum field allowing to gracefully get metadata

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `no` | Do not include metadata in the output |
| `yes` | Include metadata in the output |
| `graceful` | Include metadata in the output, but gracefully eat up errors |

### MachineOpenMode

A enum field which defines way to open TTY for a machine

| Value | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `tty` | This mode allocates a pseudo TTY in the container and returns a file descriptor and its path. This is equivalent to transitioning into the container and invoking posix_openpt(3). |
| `login` | This mode allocates a pseudo TTY in the container and ensures that a getty login prompt of the container is running on the other end. It returns the file descriptor of the PTY and the PTY path. This is useful for acquiring a pty with a login prompt from the container. |
| `shell` | This mode allocates a pseudo TTY in the container, as the specified user, and invokes the executable at the specified path with a list of arguments (starting from argv[0]) and an environment block. It then returns the file descriptor of the PTY and the PTY path. |

### ProcessId

An object for referencing UNIX processes

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `pid` | `int` | Numeric UNIX PID value |
| `pidfdId` | `?int` | 64bit inode number of pidfd if known |
| `bootId` | `?string` | Boot ID of the system the inode number belongs to |

### Timestamp

A timestamp object consisting of both CLOCK_REALTIME and CLOCK_MONOTONIC timestamps

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `realtime` | `?int` | Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_REALTIME clock (wallclock) |
| `monotonic` | `?int` | Timestamp in µs in the CLOCK_MONOTONIC clock |
